subject: Ariba onboarding: telemetry & data retention for PO/ack notifications
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lchen@rivertownhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Ariba onboarding: PO notification telemetry and retention questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the walkthrough earlier. Procurement has a couple of gating questions we need clarified before we can finish vendor registration in Ariba and sign the Order Form:

- What telemetry/operational logs are retained when Redwood sends PO/ack notifications into our Ariba instance? The attached po-notification-schema.json shows the payload we expect.
- What is the default retention period for those logs, and where are they stored (US/EU region)?
- Can we get a clause in the Order Form/MSA that specifies data residency for procurement telemetry only (we cannot move PHI/PII out of the EU region)?

We try to avoid long legal cycles, so if you can share a short redline and a recommended default, we can route internally. Also: can Redwood redact PII/PHI from the ack payloads, or will that be on our side?

Attaching the payload schema and a small sample PO XML for reference.

Thanks,
Lisa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Rivertown Health
Attachments: po-notification-schema.json (attachment), sample_po.xml (attachment)

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lchen@rivertownhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 12:10:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding: PO notification telemetry and retention questions

Hi Lisa —

Great questions, and thanks for including the schema. High level answers below; I attached a preliminary Order Form redline (draft_orderform_telemetry_redline_v1.docx) with proposed language you can pass to procurement/legal:

- Telemetry scope: Our PO/ack notifications include delivery metadata, timestamp, delivery status, and a small event log for audit. We do not include full customer PII/PHI fields by default in the notification payload unless the customer has configured custom fields in their PO mapping.
- Retention: Redwood retains raw telemetry and delivery logs for 90 days by default. Aggregated metrics are retained longer for product analytics.
- Residency: By default logs are stored in Redwood-hosted regions (US). For EU residency we can offer two options: (1) Private deployment (VPC) in EU where logs never leave region, or (2) contract-level data residency guarantee for specified telemetry types (requires an Order Form addendum).

Two immediate asks so we can produce a clean redline:
1) Confirm whether Rivertown requires EU-only storage for procurement telemetry (yes/no).
2) Confirm whether you need Redwood to actively redact any fields from the ack payload (we can redact by default for a defined list of fields).

If it helps, I can set up a 30-min call Friday to walk the procurement and security folks through the proposed wording and options. Monica/Laura — looping you in for legal and implementation comments.

Best,
Marcus
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft_orderform_telemetry_redline_v1.docx (attachment)

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:11 -0700
Subject: internal: proposed redline language for telemetry / PO acks

Marcus/Laura —

I reviewed Lisa's examples and the payload. Below are recommended redline points for the Order Form / MSA addendum. I kept the language narrow (procurement telemetry only) to reduce upstream risk:

1) Definitions: Add 'Procurement Telemetry' = "delivery receipts, status codes, timestamps, and event-level delivery logs generated solely to support transmission of purchase order acknowledgments and related operational messages".

2) Residency & Retention: "Redwood will store Procurement Telemetry in Redwood-hosted infrastructure within the geographic region selected by Customer in the Order Form. Default retention is ninety (90) days for raw logs. Upon Customer election in the Order Form, Redwood will store Procurement Telemetry in an EU-only region and retain raw logs for up to one hundred eighty (180) days. Aggregated metrics will remain in the Redwood analytics environment for thirty-six (36) months in anonymized form."

3) Redaction: "If Customer elects, Redwood will apply field-level redaction to replace values for designated sensitive fields in Procurement Telemetry prior to transmission or storage. Redaction fields must be provided by Customer in writing and agreed in the Order Form."

4) Exceptions & Law Enforcement: Add standard carve-out for lawful process.

5) SLA / Operational: Add: "For procurement-critical delivery failures, Redwood will provide an export of the Procurement Telemetry on request within five (5) business days."

Question for product/infra: can we commit to 180 days for EU storage for procurement telemetry? If not, we should offer a 90–120 day window.

Attaching a tracked changes doc and a proposed clean clause. Please review and advise on operational feasibility.

Thanks,
Monica
Commercial Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft_orderform_telemetry_redline_v1.docx (tracked changes)

---

From: Lisa Chen <lchen@rivertownhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Park <devon.park@rivertownhealth.com>, procurement@rivertownhealth.com, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding: PO notification telemetry and retention questions

Marcus/Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and suggested language. A few clarifications before we route this to legal:

- We cannot accept any possibility of PHI/PII leaving the EU region. If you can guarantee procurement telemetry residency in EU for our account that covers the majority of our ask.
- We prefer option where Redwood actively redacts PII in the payload prior to storage/transit (option 1). Can you confirm which fields you can redact out-of-the-box (e.g., patient_id, social_security_number, patient_email)?
- For our procurement team we also need PO ack payloads to exclude any free-text notes that may contain PHI. Is there a way to strip or blacklist free-text fields in the notification payload?

If you can send a clean Order Form redline with those assurances, procurement will review and (barring oddities) move to signature. We're on a tight onboarding timeline — looking to be live in Ariba by mid-July.

Best,
Lisa

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lchen@rivertownhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 15:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Ariba onboarding: PO notification telemetry and retention questions

Lisa —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick summary and proposed next steps so we can keep your Ariba deadline: 

1) Residency: We can commit to EU-only storage for Procurement Telemetry as an Order Form election for Rivertown Health (private EU tenant or EU-region logging). I'll flag this to infra; it will be scoped as an Order Form configuration and flow-through to the deployment plan.

2) Redaction: Option 1 (Redwood will apply field-level redaction prior to transmission and storage) is viable. We support out-of-the-box redaction for common fields: email, phone, national id (SSN), and a configurable list you can provide. Free-text stripping can be implemented as a filter on the PO mapping layer — we'll work with your integration team to map which fields to drop or sanitize before we send to Ariba. That will be part of the implementation checklist.

3) Retention: We can offer 180 days for EU Procurement Telemetry as a contractual term in the Order Form. Default for non-EU accounts remains 90 days. Aggregated analytics remain at 36 months anonymized.

4) Next steps / timeline:
- I attached a clean Order Form redline reflecting the EU residency election, 180-day retention, and redaction language (draft_orderform_telemetry_redline_v1.docx).
- Please provide a sample PO XML for the mapping (we already have one you attached; if there are other variants, please share).
- Proposed call: 07/01/2027 at 10:00 AM ET to finalize technical mapping and signoff.

If that all tracks for you, we will send a final DocuSign link for the Order Form addendum and kick off implementation with our integrations team. Monica/Laura — please confirm operational acceptance for the 180-day EU commitment and that redaction as specified is sufficient from a legal/compliance perspective.

Thanks —
Marcus
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft_orderform_telemetry_redline_v1.docx (clean), data_flow_diagram.png (attachment)
